```{r}


library(matrixStats)
library(data.table)
library(ontologyIndex)
library(arrow)

# For disease-disease similarity matrix
Rcpp::sourceCpp("../r/disease_sim.cpp")

```

# Load data 

```{r}

data(hpo)
hp_terms <- names(hpo$name)

```


```{r}
term_term_mat <- readRDS("../output/term_term_mat.RDS")
```


```{r}

hpo_annotations <- fread("../data/phenotype.hpoa", skip=4)
hpo_annotations <- hpo_annotations[hpo_annotations$hpo_id %in% hp_terms,]

```

# Diseases

```{r}

diseases <- unique(hpo_annotations$database_id)
sprintf("Numb of diseases: %d",length(diseases))

```


```{r}

#' The function returns annotated phenotype terms for the disease.
#' @param disease disease id
#' @return Returns a vector of HP:XXXX terms for 'disease' 
get_annotations <- function(disease){
    hpo_annotations$hpo_id[hpo_annotations$database_id == disease]
}

```

```{r}
# named list disease -> set of hp_annotations

disease_pheno_map <- setNames(
  lapply(diseases, get_annotations),
  diseases
)

```



# Disease-disease sim

d1 has n pheno
d2 has m pheno 

sim(pi,pj) = Lin sim between pi,pj

sim(d1 -> d2) = sum_i_n(max_j_m(sim(pi,pj)))/n

sim(d1,d2) = 0.5*(sim(d1 -> d2) + sim(d2 -> d1))

```{r}
#'
#'  
#' 
get_disease_disease_similarity <- function(d1,d2){
  
  p_d1 <- disease_pheno_map[[d1]]
  p_d2 <- disease_pheno_map[[d2]]
  
  n <- length(p_d1)
  m <- length(p_d2)
  
  similarities <- term_term_mat[p_d1,p_d2,drop=F]
  
  sim_d1_d2_ <- sum(rowMaxs(similarities))/n
  sim_d2_d1_ <- sum(colMaxs(similarities))/m
  
  return(0.5*(sim_d1_d2_ + sim_d2_d1_))

}

#'
#' Use this to check RCPP function
#'
get_disease_similarity_matrix <- function(diseases) {
  n <- length(diseases)
  sim_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = n)
  row.names(sim_matrix) <- diseases
  colnames(sim_matrix) <- diseases
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    for (j in i:n) {

      s <- get_disease_disease_similarity(diseases[i], diseases[j])
      sim_matrix[i, j] <- s
      sim_matrix[j, i] <- s  # mirror to lower triangle
    }
  }
  
  sim_matrix
}


```



This matrix is to check if RCPP function is correct 

```{r}
test_diseases <- diseases[1:20]
```


```{r}
sim_matrix_R <- get_disease_similarity_matrix(test_diseases)
```


# Build data

Cpp requires numeric indexes

```{r}

# term ids = hp_terms
term_ids <- row.names(term_term_mat)         
# named list term -> idx 
term_index <- setNames(seq_along(term_ids), term_ids)

# list DiseaseID -> HP pheno indexes
pheno_idx_list <- lapply(disease_pheno_map[test_diseases], function(annotated_hp) {
  idx <- unname(term_index[annotated_hp])
})

```



```{r}
sim_matrix_cpp <- disease_similarity_matrix_cpp(pheno_idx_list, term_term_mat)
rownames(sim_matrix_cpp) <- test_diseases
colnames(sim_matrix_cpp) <- test_diseases

```


## Tests 

```{r}

stopifnot(row.names(sim_matrix_cpp) == row.names(sim_matrix_R)) 
stopifnot(colnames(sim_matrix_cpp) == colnames(sim_matrix_R)) 
stopifnot(all(abs(sim_matrix_R - sim_matrix_cpp) < 1e-15))

```



# Compute disease-disease matrix

```{r}

# term ids = hp_terms
term_ids <- row.names(term_term_mat)         
# named list term -> idx 
term_index <- setNames(seq_along(term_ids), term_ids)

# list DiseaseID -> HP pheno indexes
pheno_idx_list <- lapply(disease_pheno_map[diseases], function(annotated_hp) {
  idx <- unname(term_index[annotated_hp])
})


sim_matrix_cpp <- disease_similarity_matrix_cpp(pheno_idx_list, term_term_mat)
rownames(sim_matrix_cpp) <- diseases
colnames(sim_matrix_cpp) <- diseases

```


```{r}

dim(sim_matrix_cpp)

```
```{r}

saveRDS(sim_matrix_cpp,"../output/disease_disease_sim.RDS")

```
